title: Translate FishBot 40 UI strings to Kazakh — JSON bilingual dict
description:
## Перевод интерфейса FishBot на казахский

### Строки для перевода
start_welcome, menu_diary, menu_stats, menu_forecast, menu_gear, menu_social,
menu_settings, catch_species, catch_weight, catch_location, catch_photo,
catch_note, catch_saved, catch_cancel, catch_skip, sub_free, sub_standard,
sub_pro, sub_expired, btn_back, btn_cancel, error_not_found, error_access_denied,
stats_total_catches, stats_total_weight, stats_best_catch, gear_rod, gear_reel,
gear_line, gear_hook, fish_species_pike, fish_species_perch, fish_species_carp,
fish_species_bream, fish_species_crucian, fish_species_catfish, fish_species_zander,
season_spring, season_summer, season_autumn, season_winter

### Deliverable — JSON
```json
{"ru": {"start_welcome": "..."}, "kk": {"start_welcome": "..."}}
```
Казахский литературный, рыболовные термины точные.
